summary: Completed comprehensive testing of SignGuy AI Webstore Analytics and Payouts endpoints. All 33 backend tests passed (100%). The NEW analytics, payouts, and record-payout endpoints are fully functional. Stripe Connect is MOCKED (DEV_BYPASS_STRIPE = true).

user_login.description: Login with admin credentials works correctly

create_webstore.description: Creating webstores (business, fundraiser, creator types) works

public_storefront_loads.description: GET /api/storefront/{webstore_id} returns store info without auth

place_order_auto_creates_job.description: POST /api/webstores/v2/orders creates order AND auto-creates job

analytics_endpoint.description: GET /api/webstores/v2/{id}/analytics returns summary, sales_by_day, top_products, payout_info, fundraiser_metrics

job_auto_created_from_order.description: Order creation auto-creates job with JobStatus.APPROVED

critical_code_review_comments: Analytics endpoint (GET /api/webstores/v2/{id}/analytics) correctly returns all expected fields
Payouts endpoint (GET /api/webstores/v2/{id}/payouts) returns sorted payout history
